Northwind Tools launches offline queue inspector

HARBOR CITY, Aug. 8, 2026 - Northwind Tools today announced Queue Glass, a fictional command-line utility for inspecting exported durable-work records without connecting to a production database.

The utility validates attempt identities, displays terminal retention windows, and highlights product rows whose queue evidence is absent. Reports can be saved as structured JSON for incident review.

"Operators should be able to explain a transition from durable facts," said product lead Morgan Vale. "The inspector keeps those facts readable during an investigation."

About Northwind Tools

Northwind Tools is a fictional company used only for this synthetic readability fixture. It does not offer products or collect customer information.
